pages.title: <gate title> (Decision / Confirmation / Free text / Gate / Run failed / Review ready)
pages.purpose: Needs-you sheet for one orchestration gate: shows the prompt per GateKind and, behind control capabilities, lets the person answer it, with an inline mutation receipt.

reachedFrom.trigger: ActivityScreen opened with an initial gate id: post-frame showGateSheet once the team snapshot settled (lib/ui/screens/activity_screen.dart:320); upstream trigger (notification tap) not traced

gates: an OrchestrationController exists for the connected profile (AI Team plugin on)

elements.label: Close
elements.effect: Navigator.of(context).pop(); shown with the text "This is no longer waiting on you; it was answered or closed on the host."
gates: gate id no longer in controller.snapshot.gates

elements.label: <work item title>
elements.effect: widget.onOpenWork(item.id): showGateSheet pops this sheet then calls showWorkSheet(context, controller, id).
gates: gate.kind == GateKind.gateBead (Unblocks list, non-empty) or GateKind.runFailed (Affected work, non-empty)

elements.label: <choice text> (radio row)
elements.effect: setState(_selected = index); selects the answer to send (InkWell in _Option, line 1064).
gates: tappable only when controller.capabilities.controlRespond && !hideActions && !busy; otherwise a static row

elements.label: Type your answer
elements.effect: Multi-line free-text answer bound to _text; readOnly while busy.

elements.label: Send
elements.effect: _send(() => controller.answerGate(gate.id, GateResponse.choice(choice) | GateResponse.text(text))); disabled until an option is selected / text is non-empty.
gates: hidden while record.status is MutationStatus.unconfirmed or confirmed (hideActions)

elements.label: Approve
elements.effect: Non-destructive prompt: _send(controller.answerGate(gate.id, GateResponse.confirmation(confirmed: true))) directly (line 652). Destructive prompt (teamGateIsDestructive(gate)): first opens the confirm sheet "Approve this destructive action?" via _confirm, then answers.
gates: hidden while record.status is MutationStatus.unconfirmed or confirmed (hideActions)

elements.label: Deny
elements.effect: Opens the error-tone confirm sheet "Deny this request?" via _confirm; on confirm sends controller.answerGate(gate.id, GateResponse.confirmation(confirmed: false)).
gates: hidden while record.status is MutationStatus.unconfirmed or confirmed (hideActions)

elements.label: Mark done
elements.effect: _send(controller.answerGate(gate.id, const GateResponse.confirmation(confirmed: true))) to close the gate bead.
gates: hidden while record.status is MutationStatus.unconfirmed or confirmed (hideActions)

elements.label: Retry
elements.effect: _send(controller.assignWork(item.id, agentId: target)): re-slings the stuck work item to its agent (or the run target gate.raw["target"]).
gates: hidden while record.status is MutationStatus.unconfirmed or confirmed (hideActions)

elements.label: Restart or reassign
elements.effect: widget.onOpenAgent(agentId): showGateSheet pops the sheet and pushes AgentScreen(controller, agentId).
gates: hidden while record.status is MutationStatus.unconfirmed or confirmed (hideActions)

elements.label: Watch the agent
elements.effect: widget.onOpenLogs(agentId): showGateSheet pops the sheet and calls openTeamAgentConversationById(context, controller, agentId): the agent's conversation in watching mode, or TeamWatchLiveScreen (chat-watching-live).
gates: hidden while record.status is MutationStatus.unconfirmed or confirmed (hideActions)

elements.label: Cancel work
elements.effect: Opens the confirm sheet "Cancel this work?" via _confirm; on confirm _send(controller.cancelRun(runId)).
gates: hidden while record.status is MutationStatus.unconfirmed or confirmed (hideActions)

elements.label: Retry (unconfirmed) / Try again (rejected)
elements.effect: _retry(record): controller.retryMutation(record.key) creates a new mutation record under a new key and follows it.
gates: record.status is MutationStatus.unconfirmed or rejected && record.canRetry

elements.label: How
elements.effect: showTeamHostGuideSheet(context), next to the "Answer this on the host" line.
gates: actions.isEmpty && !hideActions && record == null (no capability for this variant, or kind reviewReady/unknown)

elements.label: Technical details
elements.effect: Expands the raw provider values (request id, session id, kind, work id, run id, every raw scalar), each a TeamTechnicalValue row.

elements.label: Copy
elements.effect: Clipboard.setData(value) then SnackBar "Copied"; one per TeamTechnicalValue row.

elements.label: Close
elements.effect: Navigator.of(context).pop(). The sheet also closes itself gateSheetAnsweredBeat (900 ms) after the record is confirmed (_scheduleClose).

pages.title: Approve this destructive action? / Deny this request? / Cancel this work?
pages.purpose: Second step of a destructive gate answer (approve destructive prompt, deny, cancel run) in the error tone; nothing is sent unless confirmed.

elements.label: Approve / Deny / Cancel work
elements.effect: Pops true; the gate sheet then calls controller.answerGate(gate.id, GateResponse.confirmation(confirmed: true|false)) or controller.cancelRun(runId).

elements.label: Keep
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, false); nothing is sent.

pages.title: Ready to merge / Not ready / Merged
pages.purpose: Merge block at the end of the run Overview: readiness lines, file counts, Review changes / Approve request / two-step Merge, and the receipts.
gates: teamMergeWorkDone(run, snapshot.work): every work item completed/review/cancelled

elements.label: Review changes
elements.effect: _openChanges(readiness): showModalBottomSheet with _ChangesSheet (line 219).

elements.label: Approve request
elements.effect: _onApproveTap(request): confirm sheet, then controller.approveMergeRequest(request.id, runId: run.id).
gates: enabled only when canApprove: request != null && !approved && !approveBusy && !controller.isStale && !merged

elements.label: Merge (armed: Confirm merge)
elements.effect: _onMergeTap: first tap arms the button for teamMergeArmWindow (8 s, label "Confirm merge"); second tap disarms and opens the destructive confirm sheet, then controller.mergeRun(run.id).
gates: enabled only when canMerge: readiness != null && readiness.canMerge && !merged && !mergeBusy && !controller.isStale

pages.title: Merge into {branch}?
pages.purpose: Destructive confirmation before merging the run into the target branch.
gates: Merge button armed (second tap within 8 s)

elements.label: Merge into {branch}
elements.effect: Pops true; _onMergeTap then calls controller.mergeRun(run.id).

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, false); nothing is sent.

pages.title: Approve this merge request?
pages.purpose: Single confirmation before approving the merge request.

elements.label: Approve request
elements.effect: Pops true; _onApproveTap then calls controller.approveMergeRequest(request.id, runId: run.id).

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, false); nothing is sent.

pages.title: Changes
pages.purpose: Draggable sheet listing changed files with +/- counts (no diff) and the run's work items.

elements.label: <work item title> / <state word>
elements.effect: onOpenWork(item.id): pops this sheet and calls showWorkSheet(parent, controller, id) (line 228-230).
gates: run has work items in controller.snapshot.work

pages.title: <work item title> (Work · bead <id>)
pages.purpose: Detail sheet for one work item: cycle strip, state/owner, description, dependency and blocking chips, branch/worktree, output, validation, timestamps and raw technical details. Read-only apart from jumps.
gates: item missing from snapshot shows only "This work item is no longer on the host." (team-work-sheet-missing)

elements.label: <dependency title or id>
elements.effect: onJump(id): pops this sheet and re-opens showWorkSheet for the other item (line 50-58). Disabled when the dependency is not in the snapshot.

elements.label: <blocked item title>
elements.effect: onJump(id): pops this sheet and opens the Work sheet of the item that waits on this one.
gates: another work item lists this id in dependsOn

elements.label: Open session
elements.effect: openSession(link): calls the onOpenSession callback supplied to showWorkSheet with the linked OpenCode session id. No caller in lib/ currently passes onOpenSession, so the button never renders today.

elements.label: Technical details
elements.effect: Expands raw values (id, raw state, type, run, parent, project, assignee, session, labels, depends on, closed reason, every raw scalar).

elements.label: Copy
elements.effect: Clipboard.setData(value) then SnackBar "Copied"; one per TeamTechnicalValue row.

pages.title: [Work dependency graph]
pages.purpose: Pan/zoom dependency graph of a run's work items in the run Work tab (graph view).
gates: run Work tab with TeamWorkView.graph selected

elements.label: {title}, {state} (node chip)
elements.effect: GestureDetector.onTapUp hit-tests layout.nodeAt and calls widget.onNodeTap(node.id) (also exposed as a semantics button, line 599); RunScreen passes _openWork -> showWorkSheet.

elements.label: Fit
elements.effect: _fit(viewport, layout): resets the transform so the whole graph is visible.

pages.title: Start a run
pages.purpose: Composes an objective (project, supervision level) and sends it to the planner (Mayor) agent; shows a planner-missing/off notice instead of the form when no planner can take it.

reachedFrom.via: TeamConversation.start: the sheet, then the new task's conversation (P0.3)

elements.label: Objective (hint: What should the team achieve? One outcome, in your words.)
elements.effect: Objective text bound to _objective; empty submit shows the error text.

elements.label: Project: Let the planner choose / <project name>
elements.effect: setState(_projectId = value); the name is included in the planning message.

elements.label: Supervision: High / Balanced / Autonomous (radio rows)
elements.effect: setState(_supervision = level) (InkWell in _SupervisionRow, line 364).

elements.label: <suggested role> · Suggested from your words · Change
elements.effect: Direct task only: the role the task goes as, suggested from the typed words (TeamRolesController.suggest, updates as the person types); opens a picker of the team's roles. Send dispatches through TeamDispatchController.submit(role, roles, teamModel, applyModel).

elements.label: Send to planner
elements.effect: _send(planner): if the planner has no session, controller.controlAgent(planner.id, AgentControlAction.start) first ("waking"); then controller.messageAgent(planner.id, composeTeamPlanningMessage(...)) and pops the sheet with the MutationRecord.

elements.label: Host guide
elements.effect: showTeamHostGuideSheet(context).

elements.label: Keep in backlog
elements.effect: _keepInBacklog(): controller.createWork(title, details, projectId) — the task is made and given to no one; the sheet closes with StartRunResult(backlog: true) and the board selects its Backlog. Offered when opened from the board and the host creates work.

pages.title: Planning… (Mayor) / still planning / unconfirmed / refused
pages.purpose: Pending card on the AI Team home for one Start-a-run request that has not produced a run yet.
gates: teamPendingPlanning: request.status != TeamPlanningStatus.started and not dismissed

elements.label: Watch the planner
elements.effect: _openPlannerOutput: openTeamAgentConversationById(context, controller, request.plannerId): the planner's conversation in watching mode, or TeamWatchLiveScreen (chat-watching-live).

elements.label: Dismiss
elements.effect: controller.dismissPlanning(request.key): hides the card (app-side dismissal; the host request is untouched).

notes: lib/ui/screens/team/work_sheet.dart:319 embeds TeamCycleStrip (lib/ui/widgets/team_cycle_strip.dart, owned by i1); any interactive elements of the strip also belong on page work-sheet.

lib/ui/screens/team/work_sheet.dart:399 'Open session' needs onOpenSession, but no caller of showWorkSheet in lib/ passes it (run_screen.dart:144, gate_sheet.dart:72, merge_section.dart:230), so the button is currently unreachable.
lib/ui/screens/team/start_run_sheet.dart:308 embeds TeamBoundariesRow (policy_block.dart, not assigned to i2); grep found no onTap/onPressed in that file.
Confirm sheets are built by showConfirmSheet (lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart:10, not assigned); their confirm/cancel element lines 82/86 point into that file, the page line is the call site.
gate-sheet-approve is recorded as mutate; for destructive prompts (teamGateIsDestructive) it first opens gate-sheet-confirm-sheet (gate_sheet.dart:641).
team-phone-stop-sheet: call passes no destructive flag (team_phone_section.dart:191) but stopping the team is marked destructive: true per the brief's stop/kill rule.
activity_screen.dart:320 opens showGateSheet automatically for an initial gate id; the upstream trigger (notification tap / deep link) was not traced.
